title: Longest cave systems
measure: Total length of all surveyed passages, in km. Cavers keep finding and mapping new passages, so these figures only ever go up. Lengths are as of early 2026.

entries.name: Mammoth Cave
entries.note: Longer than the next cave by more than 140 km. A UNESCO World Heritage Site.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of longest caves (March 2026), from the NSS long cave lists and the Quintana Roo Speleological Survey

entries.name: Ox Bel Ha
entries.note: The longest underwater cave. Its flooded passages were dry caves during the last Ice Age, when sea levels were lower.
entries.source: Wikipedia, List of longest caves (March 2026), from the NSS long cave lists and the Quintana Roo Speleological Survey

entries.name: Shuanghedong
entries.note: Explored mainly since 1988, and growing fast.
